en.topic_title: China National Day: Hong Kong leader hails Five-Year Plan as astronaut sends greetings
en.topic_summary:
Chief Executive John Lee hailed the city’s first Five-Year Plan at a celebration on Thursday marking the 77th anniversary of the founding of the People’s Republic of China.



Chief Executive John Lee at the Wan Chai Exhibition Centre on October 1, 2026. Photo: GovHK.



Following a flag-raising ceremony at Golden Bauhinia Square, Lee told attendees at Wan Chai’s Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre that China had achieved a historic transformation to become the world&#82
